user.title: Choose how the inverter is connected

serial.title: Serial port (USB adapter or ESPHome serial proxy)
serial.description: Pick a local RS485 USB adapter or an ESPHome device exposing the inverter through the serial_proxy component. ESPHome proxies only show up once the ESPHome device is set up in Home Assistant.

error.esphome_not_ready: The ESPHome device is not connected yet. Wait for it to come online and try again.

abort.already_configured: An entry for this inverter connection already exists. Change its payload version from the integration's Configure button instead of adding it again.

options.serial: Serial port (USB adapter or ESPHome serial proxy)

init.title: FoxESS T Series options
init.description: Payload version 0 is used by older firmwares, 1 by newer ones that add 6 bytes after the header. If the values look shifted (e.g. grid frequency is not around 50/60 Hz), try the other version.
